text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm hm hm! ♪ Now where are they? Maybe
they're already here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen upon Matikanetannhauser on a
weekend stroll through the
park.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Out for a bit of fresh air?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well ain't that a coinkydink! I'm here
waiting for some friends myself...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there they are now! Everyone! Hey
there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look in the direction she's
waving
and see a bunch of grinning
kids quickly
approaching.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Girl
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Active Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Machi! What you got planned for us
today? Cops and robbers?
Tag? I'm pretty
fast, so I'm good for anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's see then... How about some tag in
that case? Get ready! Rock,
paper,
scissors, pyoi!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'm "it"! I'm gonna getcha, so
you better get runnin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to feel exhausted, and I'm just
watching. Even after wrapping up their
game, Matikanetannhauser looks no less
energetic than when
she started.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whew, now that was some serious fun! I
hope everyone's gotten home
okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The kids have all gone home for lunch,
leaving just myself and
Tannhauser in the
park.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Geh, that's right! Lunchtime! No goodie
good—I almost forgot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho ho, piqued your curiosity, have I?
Would you like to tag along,
then? We
could go halfsies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow behind until we arrive at the
shopping street. It's unusually crowded
today, and the air is filled with excited
shouts and the echo
of handbells.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Howdy there! I would like to give your
raffle a shot, ma'am. I have
tons of tickets!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Machitan! Pep in your step
like always, I see! Step on
over here for
the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text: I knew we'd be seein' ya today, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
Now let's see how many tickets you've got
there... Haha, you're one of our best
customers all right! Come and pull as much
as your sweet
little heart wants!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are dozens of decorated boxes lined
up on a table set up for the event.
Matikanetannhauser reaches her hand into
one of them
and pulls a lot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here goooooes!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... Oof,
it's fourth tier. Too
bad, but you do get to pick
a candy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mumu. I'm really after that Arach-kid
costume, so there's no stopping
here.
Plenty more tickets where that came from.
I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All righty, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Darn, fourth tier again. Go ahead
and pick another candy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Another fourth tier. No worries,
though! Again, again, again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How's about this?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text: Too bad. Fourth tier.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Next! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text: Too bad! Another fourth tier for you!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
Just one ticket left... What'll it be,
Machitan?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... pant... Gulp. Yeah, okay. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Lady
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry,
dear! You can do it! I believe!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
She's right!
There's no way you're losin' out
now after all those pulls.
You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You guys... Thank you! This one's for all
the marbles... Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eeeeei!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final lot is drawn!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...It's fourth tier.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Sorry, Trainer. I was planning on going halfsies with you on the Arach-kid costume and everything...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, now that I think about it, how
exactly would that work? Oh well!
Why
don't we head back?

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait right there, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
Here's a little something for your
persistence. There's enough ice
cream in
there for the two of ya, so go ahead and
split it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really? That's so nice! Thanks,
pops. I'll be back again soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Tannhauser waves goodbye to all of the
people at the shopping street, I can tell
that she hasn't lost a single ounce of her
cheerful
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the gym early the next day to
make sure our equipment is
ready for our
scheduled strength training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ei, mun! Ei, mun! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it seems that Tannhauser has beaten
me there by what looks like
a good deal of
time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! Should I hit the treadmill
next? Or maybe the
dumbbells? I think I
can hear those barbells calling my name
too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
not at all! I bet I could bench that
weight, actually. Mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You betcha!
I always feel like I get a full
charge after playing with the
kids and
doing a bit of shopping.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I can't wait 'til next weekend.
Wonder what we'll play? Hm hm
hm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser can make friends with
almost anyone she meets, and those
connections seem to give her all the
energy she could ever
need.
